tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// snyan brgyud yab bka' lus dkyil kyi sgrub thabs ye shes gter mdzod zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// bde mchog snying rje thabs kyi dngos// 'khor lo stong nyid shes rab gnyis// kha sbyor sdom pa la btud nas// de yi zab mo bskyed rim bshad// bde chen 'gyur ba med pa'i dngos// pho nya gsum bsre lam mchog gis// lus snang sems gsum sdom pa yi// rdo rje bzhi yi 'khor lor rdzogs/ de la 'dir bde mchog lus dkyil du bsgrubs par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis phyi dkyil lhan skyes dang*/ lus dkyil 'di nyid du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod la sogs pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gnas su gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa 'gro ba 'don pa'i 'dod pa dang ldan pas rnal 'byor gyi yo byad bzang pos mdun bstar nas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste bsgom par bya ba la/ sngon dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// deng nas brtsams te mgon med bdag /snying po byang chub ma thob bar// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// bdag dang 'gro rnams skyabs pa'i phyir// rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum bdag /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das// zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi// tshogs kyi mchog gyur sa la bzhugs// phyir mi ldog la skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// gnyug ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ mgon po khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags// phyin chad sdig las ldog par bgyi// deng nas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi// khyed kyi bslab bya rjes su slob// khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' bas// kun nas yongs su bskyab tu gsol//

lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ de nas bum pa'i nang du pad nyi la khaṃ yongs su gyur pa las dum skyes ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro yi gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur par bsam la/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lha 'od du zhu ba'i chu dag byed kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam pas phyi khrus bya/ de nas rdo rje'i chu 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pas nang gi khrus dang*/ rdo rje sems pa'i sgom bzlas kyis gsang khrus byas la/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor ma// de sras tilli nā ro dang*// lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan mar mi la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// ras chung zhabs dang khyung tshang pa// ma gcig kong jo lo chen zhang*// dha ra shrī bsod nams mtshan// gsol ba= /kun ldan ras ma bde legs// kun dga' dpal dang rgyal ba'i dbang*// ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po la// gsol= ma bgrangs bcu gsum sa bgrod de// rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal tshab tu// mkha' 'gros lung bstan padma dkar// gsol ba=

/rgyal tshab dam pa lha rtse'i zhabs// snying rje'i dbang phyug dpag bsam dbang*// 'jam dbyangs budha kun dga' rjer// gsol ba= /mkhas mchog yar 'phel thugs rdo rje// bde chen zhabs dang 'jam pa'i dpal// kun gzigs chos kyi snang ba la// gsol ba= /mtshungs med mkhas grub chos kyi rje// 'jam dpal ye shes grub pa dang*// nges don chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zhabs// gsol ba= /rdo rje slob dpon mtshungs med rje// 'jam dpal shes bya kun mkhyen dang*// ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog /gsol ba= /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'brug pa rje/ 'jigs med mi pham chos kyi dbang*// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong yang*// gang gi rol rtsed yin shes nas// rje btsun bla ma khyed min pa'i// skyabs gzhan bdag cag rnams mi 'tshol// de phyir nyam nga'i 'khor ba nas// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i thugs rje'i mthu// bskul ba'i gsol ba 'debs lags na// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// smin byed dbang gis rgyud sros nas// grol lam gser 'gyur rtsis sbran pa'i// mi gtsang lus 'di rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen mchog tu gyur cig gu/ bar dang*/ sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sku thob shog /gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// 'jam dbyangs chen po 'grub gyur cig /thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhugs// 'pho med bde ba che thob shog /ji ltar chu la chu bzhag ltar// bdag dang gnyis med gcig gyur nas// sa bcu'i mgon po 'grub gyur cig / ces dbang bzhi blangs la zhu bstim byas pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur par bsam/ de nas bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i chang la/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi khar a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang phyogs bzhir hūm̐ oṃ khāṃ āṃ traṃ dang*/

bāṃ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sa bon dang bcas pa rlung gis me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ de'i khar āḥlas zla ba la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug de dag kyang zhu ba dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ dngos gzhi la srung 'khor/ bsod nams kyi tshogs/ tshad med/ ye shes kyi tshogs/ rten dkyil 'khor/ brten pa lha/ lus dkyil gsal 'debs/ go bgo/ ye shes dgug pa/ dbang*/ rdor bzlas/ rdzogs rim te bcu gnyis so/ de las dang po/ oṃ ā hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang gi lus he ru ka gsal ba 'od du zhu nas/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po gsum du gyur cing*/ steng nas steng du rtsegs mar gnas pa'i oṃ āḥl/ āḥhūm̐ la hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu ha/ de mgo bo/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da/ de yang mi dmigs par gyur pa dang lhan cig shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// zhes pa'i don cung zad dran par byas te/ de las/ rang nyid skad cig gis bde mchog dpa' bo gcig par gyur pa'i snying khar pad zla la hūm̐ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bskor ba/ de las rdo rje dpag tu med pa phyi rol tu 'phros pa rnams 'dus pas rdo rje'i gur khang*/ cis kyang mi shigs pa/ oṃ hri gha gha/ ghā ta ya/ ghā ta ya/ ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭā na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ slar 'od zer gyi sna la sgo mtshams kyi khro mo bzhugs pa phyogs brgyad du spros pas bgegs thams cad bcings phur bus bsnun/ de tho bas brdungs nas thal bar brlags te khro mo rnams me 'od kyi phreng bar gyur nas rdo rje gur rnam par dkris pas bskal pa'i me lta bur 'bar bar gyur/

gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ yang*/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus 'khor lo lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor bla ma steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ na maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ gis phyag 'tshal/ snying kha'i sa bon las gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rang ming gi mchod pa'i yo byad thogs pa rnams kyis/ oṃ āḥbadzra a darsha hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ badzra bī ni= badzra gandhe= badzra rā sa= badzra sparshe= badzra dharme= ces dang*/ yid kyis phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa phul/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lnga rnam dag bya/ tshogs zhing maṇḍal muḥ zhes pas rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ gsum pa tshad med ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / lan gsum/ slar yang sems can thams cad mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal las phyung ste bde ba chen po la dgod pa'i phyir dpal he ru ka'i bsgrub pa la 'jug par bya'o// snyam smon pa byas te/ bzhi ye shes kyi tshogs 'jug pa la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ lnga pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha rdzas kyi rin po che 'ba' zhig las grub pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhi lte bar nyi gdan la/ drug pa brten pa lha ni/

gdan dbus mar a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ tshar gnyis g.yon/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ tshar gnyis g.yas/ ā li dang kā li yongs su gyur pa las dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs su gyur cing tshur bsdus pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ de las phyogs bzhir hūm̐ bzhi mched pa rnams skad cig la yongs su gyur pa las/ lte bar bdag nyid mthing shun lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gis rdo rje phag mo li khri lta bu la 'khyud pa/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pas mkha' 'gro ma nag mo la 'khyud pa/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas lā ma ljang khu la 'khyud pa/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po padma dang padma'i dril bu 'dzin pas dum skyes ma dmar mo la 'khyud pa/ lhor rin chen 'byung gnas ser po rin po che dang*/ rin po che'i dril bu 'dzin pas gzugs can ma ser mo la 'khyud pa/ yab rnams drang srong gzhon nu cung zad khros pa'i gzugs/ rjes su chags pas gzigs pa'i spyan gsum mnga' ba/ ral pa'i thor tsugs kyi rtser nor bu/ ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje/ zur du zla phyed/ rin po che'i rtse phran dang bcas pa'i thod pa'i prog zhu/ snyan gong utpal dar dpyangs dang bcas pa gsol ba/ phyag rgya drug dang mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi ga shal phrag par 'dzin cing stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs mnabs te zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan dang g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed brdzis pa/

yum rnams gcer mo thod skam gyi 'phreng ba dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan te phyag g.yas pa rang rtags 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa thod khrag yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ byin pa gnyis yab la 'khril zhing*/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me'i phung po 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab mar byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// bdun pa lus dkyil gsal 'debs pa/ de ltar rkang pa gnyis bsgrad pa gzhu'i dbyibs can rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdo gru gsum me/ lto ba zlum po chu/ brang gru bzhi sa/ sgal tshigs lhun po/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi mnyam pa gzhal yas khang*/ snying sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la/ a ā nas dbyangs tshar gnyis g.yon/ ka kha ga nas yar la wa ḍa ḍha/ gsal byed gnyis g.yas/ ā li dang kā li yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma dang zla ba kha sbyar gyi dbus su/ hūm̐ dngul chu lta bu dang a li khri lta bu las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur cing tshur 'dus pas rdo rje hūm̐ dang gri gug as mtshan pa/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ind+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tsugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/

zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thams can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra st+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ thod pa dum bu'i ska rags can/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ bāṃ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ zhu ba las/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// lha mo de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ pū dzā o a go rā de mā kā o tri ko ka laṃ kā hi pre gṛ sau su na si ma ku/ de zhu ba las 'tshogs ma pu li ra mar dpa' bo thod pa'i duum bu dang dpa' mo rab gtum ma/

spyi gtsug dzālandha rar keṃ rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas u rgyan du keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang*/ sna chen ma/ bzhi gnas/ rna ba g.yon go dā wa rir lha dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ smin mtshams rā me shwa rir 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig de wi ko ṭir rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa mā la war rdo rje lus dang shing grib ma nye ba'i gnas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas/ mchan khung kā ma ru par myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ nu ma gnyis o ṭir rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo gnyis zhing*/ lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ gnyis nye zhing*/ kha ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs ma/ mgrin pa laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ gnyis tshandho/ snying kāñtsi kar 'jigs byed dang rta rna ma/ 'doms hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma gnyis nye ba'i tshandho/ gsung gi 'khor lo sa spyod kyi gnas/ mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang laṃ gṛ ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ gnyis 'du ba/ brla gnyis la sau raṣṭar rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ byin pa gnyis su waraṇṇa dwī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo phal pa rnams na ga rar he ru ka dang bzhin bzang mo/ bol gong gnyis sindhur padma gar dbang dang stobs chen ma gnyis dur khrod/ mthe bong ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo/ gnyis nye ba'i dur khrod/ sku'i dkyil 'khor sa 'og spyod kyi gnas/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ thugs kyi g.yas rdo rje dang*/

gsung gi padma dang*/ sku'i 'khor lo g.yon de so sos yu ba byas pa'i dril bu gzung ste dpa' mo la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal can/ phyag rgya drug gi brgyan te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'i pang na dpa' mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhu ba las/ lce'i lkog gtum drag tu khwa gdong ma nag mo/ sna rtse tshang tshing 'khrigs par 'ug gdong ma/ mtshan rtse 'ur 'ur 'bar bar khyi gdong ma/ bshang sgo'i 'jigs byed thod par phag gdong ma/ rna ba g.yas dbang phyug nags tshal du gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ rna ba g.yon mun pa mi bzad par gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ mig g.yas ki li ki la'i sgra sgrog par gshin rje mche ba mo g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ mig g.yon ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro yi gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs rnams snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon lta bur bsgom par bya'o// gnas ni rab tu dga' ba/ nye gnas dri ma med pa/ zhing 'od byed/ nye zhing 'od 'phro/ tshandho sbyang dka'/ nye ba'i tshandho mngon gyur/ 'du ba ring du song ba/ nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba/ dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros/ nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin te/
gnas dang gnas pa thams cad sa bcur rnam par dag pa'o

snyam du bsam par bya'o// de nas lha tsam du zhen pa yod pas de spang ba'i phyir lha de dag kyang byang chub kyi phyogs sum cu rtsa bdun no snyam pas kun rdzob pa'i cha nas lhar snang ma dor gshis lugs spros pa dang bral bas stong nyid ma dor bas snang stong zung 'jug gi ngo bo zhig bsgom par bya'o/ brgyad pa go bgo ba la/ de nas lha lnga dang snying kha'i gtso bo'i snying kar oṃ haḥ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ na ma hi dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swa hā hu spyi bor rin chen 'byung gnas dmar po/ bau ṣa ṭa he phrag pa gnyis la he ru ka nag po/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ spyan gsum la 'od dpag med mthing ka phaṭ haṃ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad la don yod grub pa ljang khu/ yum rnams kyi lte bar oṃ paṃ phag mo dmar mo/ haṃ yau snying gar gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ khar rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hreṃ hriṃ dpral bar skyod byed ma ser mo// hūm̐ hūm̐ spyi bor skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad la tsanḍi ka dud kha/ thams cad kyang gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yab rnams thor tshugs stag sham/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ yum rnams skra grol gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// dgu pa ye shes dgug pa la/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i snying ga'i bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa thams cad du 'phros/ oṃ yo ga shuddhāḥsarba dha rmā/ yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ padma lag kor dang bcas pas/ 'og min gyi zhing nas bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i bcom ldan 'das rten dkyil 'khor brten pa lha'i tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa la snying kha nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mos/ oṃ āḥbadzra a darsha hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ badzra bī ni= badzra gandhe= badzra rā sa= badzra sparshe= badzra dharme= ces mchod/ lā ma sogs bzhis/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pu tsa khā hi/

nang mchod bdud rtsi phul/ mchod lha rnams so so'i yum la thim pas gsang mchod 'bul/ brtan g.yo'i sgra tshogs bstod par 'char bas/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ sogs kyis 'go drangs/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod paṇa dbu yi brgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul rngams pa'i zhal// sku la phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭwāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang bsgyur las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigasapa pham zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog par 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces rkang pa brgyad pas bstod nas/ bcu pa dbang ni/ rgyas par maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas dbang len/ de tsam long med na rgyun gyi lam dbang ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas lus kyi dkyil 'khor las spros pa'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

zhes phyi nang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur chu rgyun gyis lus gang*/ dri ma dag /lhag ma yar 'khyil bas gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang*/ gzhan thams cad la rdo rje'i bsgreng bu res mtshan par gyur par bsam pa bum dbang*/ de nas lha tshogs de thams cad snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems sbyor mtshams nas lce thog tu babs/ des lus thams cad khyab pa gsang dbang*/ rang dkyil 'khor par bsams pa rnams snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i bde ba mngon sum du byas pa sher dbang*/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba la rtse gcig tu gzhag pa bzhi pa'o// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmadun gyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor de dag bdag dang snying ga'i lha rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rigs kyi bdag por thim par bsam/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mngon par mchod par mos la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ padyaṃ= añtsa ma naṃ= prokṣa ṇaṃ= dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed cing*// mdzes ldan dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*// me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dkyil 'khor kun= yid 'ong dud kha rdo rje dril bu dang*// bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha'= dhu pe= dkyil 'khor= kun snang dmar ser rdo rje dril bu= mar me gang ba'i= nam mkha'= ā lo ke= gdung sel ljang khu rdo rje= dri chab byug pa'i rin= nam mkha'= gandhe= dkyil 'khor= zhal zas ser mo rdo rje dril bu= bdud rtsi gang ba'i rin chen= nam mkha'= nai widya= dkyil 'khor= sgra snyan sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu dang*// pi wang gling bu rnga chen sogs 'dzin ma// nam mkha'= shapta ratna huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

ces phyi'i lha mos mchod/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis ka pa la bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas mchod par gyur/ lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga// dngos grub kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga thob shog /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ zhes nang bdud rtsi myang ba dang*/ mdzes ma 'di dag phyag rgya che// mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo// rigs lnga las byung 'di phul bas// rigs pa'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin shog / ces gsang ba snyoms 'jug dang*/ rang rdzas mdzes pa nyid kyi rdzas// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// thams cad stong pa mngon sum du// byas la bde chen skad cig gis// rdzogs par byas la mchod par bya/ /zhes de kho na nyid rang rig bde chen gyis mchod/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg ni sanni bhā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ṭā mu ku ṭo ta ka ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṣṭaṃ ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho dya ta shul kha ṭwāṃ ga dhā ra ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bya ghra dzi nāṃ ba ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā dhu ma brāndha kā ra ba pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzra wā rā hi baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ārya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya rā ma te ma hā bi dye shwa ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bhu ta bha ya ba he ma hā badzre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba shaṃ ka ri ne tra bhrā ma ṇī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ be ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā ni li nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tra sa ni ma ra ni su pra bhe da ni pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ye bi dzaṃ ye dzaṃ bha ni staṃ bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ badzra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī ka me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ yab yum zhal sbyor bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du yod pa'i yab kyi shangs bug g.yas nas srog hūm̐ nag po'i rnam par 'phros pas snang ba thams cad bde bar lhang song*/ tshur log dus oṃ gyi tshul du yum gyi bha ga nas zhugs/ a wa dhū tī brgyud yum gyi shangs g.yas nas yab kyi g.yon du 'khor/ āḥyi rang bzhin du lte bar gnas par bsam pa rdo rje bzlas pa'o// yang na rdo rje'i rtser thig le dkar la 'tsher ba phra la 'gril ba yungs kar tsam/ yum gyi ze'u 'bru'i rtser de lta bu'i thig le dmar po gcig bsams te/ des yab kyi thig le dkar po bzhu nas ches cher 'bar ba'i rkyen du byas te yab kyi nor bu'i bu ga nas a wa dhū tī'i nang nas zhugs/ haṃ la reg /bde ba'i nyams rgyud la skyes/ haṃ las byang sems babs/ des me lce gyen du bzlog par bsams te kha sbyor gyi rlung bum pa can bsgom/ yang na he ru ka'i thugs kar nyi ma la sa bon sngags 'phreng bkod/ 'od zer gyi dra ba phan tshun du 'brel bas 'ja'i gur phub pa lta bu la dmigs te sngags ngag du bzla/ sngags ni/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la saṃ wa raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yab sngags dang*/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa na ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ ces yum sngags so/ de nas 'khor gyi bzlas pa la 'jug par/ dang por mdun gyi rnam snang he ru ka'i thugs kar nyi la hūm̐ dkar po'i mthar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs te/ oṃ shrī buddha he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la saṃ wa raṃ swā hā/ de bzhin karma/ padma/ ratna rnams kha sgyur bya zhing*/ yum sngags kyang

/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin/ oṃ sarba badzra ḍā ki nī ye= ratna/ padma/ karma kha sgyur zhing*/ nye snying mi dgos/ lā ma sogs bzhi'i sngags sgrub thabs thun mong ltar ro/ de'i rjes su/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ sogs go cha'i rtsa sngags rnams kyang bzla bar bya'o/ yab rnams kyi thugs srog hūm̐ yig rang rang gi mdog dang*/ yum rnams la maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ so so'i sku mdog lta bu'o/ /rjes la rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis sems can gyi don ma lus pa byas te tshur log rang la thim par bsam mo// de ltar bzlas pas dub na/ snying ga'i 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad bsdus te gzhal yas khang la/ de yang me long la rlangs pa 'du ba bzhin he ru ka lnga la/ 'khor bzhi gtso bo la/ gtso bo'i lus kyi dpa' mo nyer bzhi rtsa'i rang bzhin/ dpa' bo khams byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam pas gang bar gyur pa/ de dag lha mo bcu gnyis la/ de dbus kyi gtso bo yab yum la/ yum yab la/ de yas 'dus mas 'dus te nyi ma'i steng gi hūm̐ ye shes lnga'i ngo bo la/ de rim gyis 'dus te sgra ris tsam de yang stong nyid du yal bas phyi'i sku gcig tu 'dus par gyur pa/ de'i lus oṃ la/ ngag āḥl yid hūm̐/ gnyis po hūm̐ gcig pu la/ de yang nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa bzhin je chung du song nas stong nyid dbyings dang dbyer med du gyur pa la mnyam par gzhag / de nas rjes spyod dmangs kyi rnal 'byor dag la 'jug par gsungs pa ni/ grub chen gling gis rnal 'byor 'jug par gsungs pa dag yin la/ 'dir slob ma rjes 'dzin sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga la 'jug par 'dod na mdun bskyed phyi dkyil la brten pas te/ ras bris dkyil 'khor bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang gzhi mtshungs par/

padma 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs rigs bzhi'i he ru ka yab yum gyi lha mtshan bkod pas so/ gzhan gtor mchod sogs bcu gsum ma'i skabs ltar 'du bya zhing*/ bum pa sogs dbang gi rdzas rnams kyang tshogs par byas la bdag gi rnal 'byor/ rdor bzlas/ ngag bzlas bcas grub nas/ mdun dkyil khaṇḍa ro hi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha rdzas kyi rin po che 'ba' zhig las grub pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi gdan la hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs su gyur cing tshur bsdus pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ de las phyogs bzhir hūm̐ bzhi mched pa rnams skad cig la yongs su gyur pa las/ lte bar bdag nyid mthing shun lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gis rdo rje phag mo li khri lta bu la 'khyud pa/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pas mkha' 'gro ma nag mo la 'khyud pa/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas lā ma ljang khu la 'khyud pa/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po padma dang padma'i dril bu 'dzin pas dum skyes ma dmar mo la 'khyud pa/ lhor rin chen 'byung gnas ser po rin po che dang*/ rin po che'i dril bu 'dzin pas gzugs can ma ser mo la 'khyud pa/ yab rnams drang srong gzhon nu cung zad khros pa'i gzugs/ rjes su chags pas gzigs pa'i spyan gsum mnga' ba/ ral pa'i thor tsugs kyi rtser nor bu/

ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje/ zur du zla phyed/ rin po che'i rtsa phran dang bcas pa'i thod pa'i srog zhu/ snyan gong utpal dar dpyangs dang bcas pa gsol ba/ phyag rgya drug dang mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi ga shal phrag par 'dzin cing stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs mnabs te zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan dang g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed brdzis pa/ yum rnams gcer mo thod skam gyi 'phreng ba dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan te phyag g.yas pa rang rtags 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa thod khrag yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ byin pa gnyis yab la 'khril zhing*/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me'i phung po 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab mar byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// bdun pa lus dkyil gsal 'debs pa/ de ltar rkang pa gnyis bsgrad pa gzhu'i dbyibs can rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdo gru gsum me/ lto ba zlum po chu/ brang gru bzhi sa/ sgal tshigs lhun po/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi mnyam pa gzhal yas khang*/ snying sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la/ a ā nas dbyangs tshar gnyis g.yon/ ka kha ga nas yar la wa ḍa ḍha/ gsal byed gnyis g.yas/ a li dang kā li yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma dang zla ba kha sbyar gyi dbus su/ hūm̐ dngul chu lta bu dang a li khri lta bu las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur cing tshur 'dus pas rdo rje hūm̐ dang gri gug as mtshan pa/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ind+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/

rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thams can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra st+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ thod pa dum bu'i ska rags can/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ zhu ba las/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ gtso bo'i thugs khar sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ dngul chu lta bu dang a li khri lta bu las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/

bcud 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur cing tshur 'dus pas rdo rje hūm̐ dang gri gug as mtshan pa/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ind+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tsugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thams can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra st+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ thod pa dum bu'i ska rags can/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/

māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ zhu ba las/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// lha mo de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga cu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ pu dzā o a go rā de mā kā o tri ko ka laṃ kā hi pre gṛ sau su na si ma ku/ de zhu ba las 'tshogs ma pu li ra mar dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang dpa' mo rab gtum ma/ spyi gtsug dzālandha rar keṃ rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas u rgyan du keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa arpu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang*/ sna chen ma/ bzhi gnas/ rna ba g.yon go dā wa rir lha dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ smin mtshams rā me shwa rir 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig de wi ko ṭir rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa mā la war rdo rje lus dang shing grib ma nye ba'i gnas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas/ mchan khung kā ma ru par myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ nu ma gnyis o ṭir rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo gnyis zhing*/ lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ gnyis nye zhing*/ kha ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs ma/ mgrin pa laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ gnyis tshandho/ snying kāñtsi kar 'jigs byed dang rta rna ma/

'doms hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma gnyis nye ba'i tshandho/ gsung gi 'khor lo sa spyod kyi gnas/ mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang laṃ gṛ ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ gnyis 'du ba/ brla gnyis la sau raṣṭar rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ byin pa gnyis su waraṇṇa dwī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo phal pa rnams na ga rar he ru ka dang bzhin bzang mo/ bol gong gnyis sindhur padma gar dbang dang stobs chen ma gnyis dur khrod/ mthe bong ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo/ gnyis nye ba'i dur khrod/ sku'i dkyil 'khor sa 'og spyod kyi gnas/ dpa' bo tham cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ thugs kyi g.yas rdo rje dang*/ gsung gi padma dang*/ sku'i 'khor lo g.yon de so sos yu ba byas pa'i dril bu gzung ste dpa' mo la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral ba'i thor tsugs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal can/ phyag rgya drug gi brgyan te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'i pang na dpa' mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhu ba las/ lce'i lkog gtum drag tu khwa gdong ma nag mo/ sna rtse tshang tshing 'khrigs par 'ug gdong ma/ mtshan rtse 'ur 'ur 'bar bar khyi gdong ma/ bshang sgo'i 'jigs byed thod par phag gdong ma/ rna ba g.yas dbang phyug nags tshal du gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ rna ba g.yon mun pa mi bzad par gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ mig g.yas ki li ki la'i sgra sgrog par gshin rje mche ba mo g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/

mig g.yon ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro yi gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs rnams snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon lta bur bsgom par bya'o// gnas ni rab tu dga' ba/ nye gnas dri ma med pa/ zhing 'od byed/ nye zhing 'od 'phro/ tshandho sbyang dka'/ nye ba'i tshandho mngon gyur/ 'du ba ring du song ba/ nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba/ dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros/ nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin te/ gnas dang gnas pa thams cad sa bcur rnam par dag pa'o/ lha lnga dang snying kha'i gtso bo'i snying khar oṃ haḥ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ na ma hi dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swa hā hu spyi bor rin chen 'byung gnas dmar po/ bau ṣa ṭa he phrag pa gnyis la he ru ka nag po/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥspyan gsum la 'od dpag med mthing ka phaṭ haṃ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad la don yod grub pa ljang khu/ yum rnams kyi lte bar oṃ baṃ phag mo dmar mo/ haṃ yau snying gar gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ khar rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hreṃ hriṃ dpral bar skyod byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ spyi bor skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad la tsanḍi ka dud kha/ thams cad kyang gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yab rnams thor tshugs stag sham/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ yum rnams skra grol gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa thams cad du 'phros/ oṃ yo ga shuddhāḥsarba dha rmā/
yo ga shuddho3haṃ/

padma lag skor dang bcas pas/ 'og min gyi zhing nas bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i bcom ldan 'das rten dkyil 'khor brten pa lha'i tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥbadzra a darsha hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ badzra bī ni= badzra gandhe= badzra rā sa= badzra sparshe= badzra dharme= ces mchod/ lā ma sogs bzhis/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pu tsa khā hi/ nang mchod bdud rtsi phul/ mchod lha rnams so so'i yum la thim pas gsang mchod 'bul/ brtan g.yo'i sgra tshogs bstod par 'char bas/ gang gis drin gyi bde chen nyid/ sogs kyis 'go drangs/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod paṇa dbu yi brgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul rngams pa'i zhal// sku la phyag steng gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭwāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen dung kha bgegs mthar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang bsgyur las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can dag snyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigasapa pham zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog par 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces rkang pa brgyad pas bstod nas/

bcu pa dbang ni/ rgyas par maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas dbang len/ de tsam long med na rgyun gyi lam dbang ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas lus kyi dkyil 'khor las spros pa'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes phyi nang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur chu rgyun gyis lus gang*/ dri ma dag /lhag ma yar 'khyil bas gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang*/ gzhan thams cad la rdo rje'i bsgreng bu res mtshan par gyur par bsam pa bum dbang*/ de nas lha tshogs de thams cad snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems sbyor mtshams nas lce thog tu babs/ des lus thams cad khyab pa gsang dbang*/ rang dkyil 'khor par bsams pa rnams snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i bde ba mngon sum du byas pa sher dbang*/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba la rtse gcig tu gzhag pa bzhi pa'o// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmadun gyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor de dag bdag dang snying ga'i lha rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mngon par mchod par mos la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ padyaṃ= añtsa ma naṃ= prokṣa ṇaṃ= dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed cing*// mdzes ldan dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*// me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dkyil 'khor kun= yid 'ong dud kha rdo rje dril bu dang*// bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha'= dhu pe= dkyil 'khor= kun snang dmar ser rdo rje dril bu= mar me gang ba'i= nam mkha'= ā lo ke=

gdung sel ljang khu rdo rje= dri chab byug pa'i rin= nam mkha'= gandhe= dkyil 'khor= zhal zas ser mo rdo rje dril bu= bdud rtsi gang ba'i rin chen= nam mkha'= nai widya= dkyil 'khor= sgra snyan sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu dang*// pi wang gling bu rnga chen sogs 'dzin ma// nam mkha'= shapta ratna huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang*/ dzambu'i gser las rang byung lte ba zlum// rtsibs stong mu khyud mchog tu rnam 'phrul ba// mkha' la rab 'phags phyogs las rgyal byed pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ tsakra ratna pra tītstsha swā hā/ thal kar mche ba drug pa zla 'od can// chu zheng phun tshogs yud kyis mkha' lam nas// sa chen rgya mtsho'i ska rags can bskor ba'i// glang po rin chen= hasti ratna= spu kha rma bya'i mgrin 'dra yid 'ong zhing*// gser gyi rgyan ldan mgyogs pa yid lta bus// tho rangs sa rnams bskor te slar ldog pa'i// rta mchog rin chen= a shwa ratna= kun tu sngo ba snang byed bai ḍūrya// nyin mor byed pa 'od kyis rnam gnon cing*// bsam pa rdzogs byed legs sbyangs cha brgyad pa// nor bu rin chen= ma ni ratna= 'chi med bu mo bzhin du gzugs mdzes shing*// reg bya mchog gis lus sems bde byed pa// sgyu rtsal kun shes smra mkhas dri bzang ster// btsun mo rin chen= st+rī ratna= phur ba'i blo ldan mdzangs shing yid gzhung pa/ khor yug gter gyis 'dod dgur 'dzud byed cing*// des pa snyan pa'i tshig 'byin lha mig can// khyim bdag rin chen= pu ru ṣa ratna= sred med bu yi stobs ldan dpa' ba dang*// rtul phod yid la rgyas pa'i don rnams kun// mod la sgrub cing phas rgol med byed pa// blon po rin chen/ khaḍga ratna= 'od zer gyis sngo ral gri lpags pa 'jam// dga' ba'i nags tshal gos ni yid rjes 'gro// mthu ldan mchil lham khang khyim gzhal du med// reg 'jam gzim cha=

u pa ratna= / ces rin chen bdun gyis mchod/ rab mdzes lta bas ming ngom lang tsho can// dga' ba'i nyams bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga ma// rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bas mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadzra wi ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ waṃ she= mu rañdze= mṛ taṃ ge= rab mdzes= /mchog dga'i nyams= /bzhad dang dregs ldan glu dbyangs gar mkhan mas// rab 'byams= ha sya= lā sya= girti= nirti= rab mdzes= /khyad dga'i nyams= /me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri chab ma// rab 'byams= puṣpe= dhu pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= rab mdzes= /lhan skyes dga' bzhis= /gzugs bcud reg bya chos dbyings rdo rje mas// rab 'byams= rū pa= rā sya= sparshe= dharma dhartu= ces phyi'i lha mos mchod/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas mchod par gyur/ oṃ mchod do phud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rigs thams cad kyi dbang phyug dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rtsa rgyud kyi rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza kha hi/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la sambha raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrī ha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza kha hi/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med ba'i zhal du pañtsa a mṛ pū dza khā hi/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i= dpal ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum gyi sman pa/

gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma chen mo bya rog ming can 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i= gzhan yang yul phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa la sogs lha ma srin sde brgyad 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pu dza khā hi/ ces nang mchod bdud rtsi phul/ lha dang mi yi bde ba ni// bsdus byas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid// bcu drug char yang mi phod pa'i// dga' ba bla na med pas mchod// ces gsang ba snyoms 'jug gis mchod/ rang rdzas mdzes pa nyid kyi rdzas/ stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// stong pa chen po'i rgyu de yis// thams cad stong pa mngon sum du// byas la bde chen skad cig gis// rdzogs par byas te mchod par bya// ces de kho na nyid rang rig bde chen gyis mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ gang gis drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs shlau ka dang*/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi brgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul rngams pa'i zhal// sku la phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭwāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen dung kha bgegs mthar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang bsgyur las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa pham zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog par 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod//

ces rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ snyan brgyud yab bka'i phyogs 'dir mdun bskyed la bzlas pa mi 'byung bas/ bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i slad du bum bskyed bya ba ste/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lnga'am/ ma 'dzoms na rnam rgyal bum pa dang*/ las kyi bum pa gnyis gtsang mar bkrus/ spos kyis bdug /dar sngon po'i mgul dkris dang*/ bum mtshan bkod/ nyer lnga'i rdzas bcas chus sum gnyis bgang*/ rnam rgyal gyi khar thod pa'am dung chos gzungs rdor bcas ku sha'i gdan la bkod/ de nas shū n+ya ta sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bum pa bzang po'i nang du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ kha dog lnga yongs su gyur pa las lte bar mthing shun lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das sogs mdun bskyed ltar gyi nub dang las bum du dum skyes ma zhes brjod pa tsam gyis khyad/ ces bskyed cing spyan drangs ba'i mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bum pa'i lha dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas mchod pa ni/ lha yi me tog shin tu 'bar// lha yi dri yis nye bar byugs// me tog bzang po 'di bzhes la// gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol// oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ tsandan gu gum sbyar ba yi// dri mchog bdug spos dam pa 'di// dbang po'i sgo rnams tshim pa'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs la bzhes su gsol// dhū pe= mar me 'od bzang 'bar ba 'di// ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed cing*// lha yi mig 'byed dam pa 'di// bdag la dgongs te bzhes su gsol// dī paṃ= sna tshogs lha yi dri dang ldan// sna tshogs ga bur gyis ni brgyan// sna tshogs hūṃ las yang dag byung*// dri mchog 'di dag= gandhe= kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// bza' ba'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*// zhal zas thams cad phun sum tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du=

nai wī dya= zhing 'di rgyal srid sna bdun gyis// mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste// dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i phyir// nyin bzhin shes rab can gyis mchod// oṃ āḥratna sapta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ phyi mchod do/ bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'phrul// pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can// brgyad gnyis lang tsho dpal 'bras nu 'bur ma// bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma// nya rgyas zla ba dag pa'i bzhin ras ma// tshems zhing gsal ba bdun rtsi'i 'od ldan ma// rdo rje rig ma lha mos deng mchod na// mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod// oṃ āḥbadzra wi ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin waṃ she= mu rañdze= mṛ taṃ ge= bde mchog sgyu ma'i= rgod dang dregs ldan glu dbyangs rol gar mkhan// zur mig 'phen mkhas 'dod pa'i mda' 'phen ma// 'chi med na chung sgyu ma'i 'jo sgeg ma// yid 'phrog dpa' mo rdo rje'i glu dbyangs ma// 'gying gzugs glog 'dra gar dgu'i rtsed 'jo ma// rdo rje rig ma= /mchog tu= hā sye= lā sye= gī tī= nṛtye= bde mchog= me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog 'dzin// rnam rgyas pad dkar gzhon nu'i zhal mdzes ma// dri zhim mar me gsar pa'i dri ldan ma// mtshar sdug 'od kyi phyogs cha rnam 'gengs ma// gu bur tsandan shing ltar gdung sel ma// rdo rje= mchog tu= puṣpe= dhu pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= bde mchog= gzugs bcud reg bya chos kyi lha mo ni// mdzes sdug dpe byad bzang po'i dpal ldan ma// ma mchu bdud rtsi gtsang ma'i ro ldan ma// reg byas dbang po kun nas tshim byed ma// bsam yas lhan cig skyes dga'i 'byung gnas ma// rdo rje= mchog= rū pa= ra sye= spharshe= oṃ āḥbadzra dharma dhā tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ oṃ mchod do byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces nang mchod dang*/ lha dang mi yi bde ba sogs gsang mchod dang*/ rang rdzas mdzes pa sogs rang rig bde chen gyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan mgon po'i dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni/ sogs/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bar gyis bstod/ sngags phreng rnams bdag gi kha nas thon/ gzungs thag la 'khril/ rnam rgyal chen po dang bum pa'i nang du song bas lha rnams chags pa bdo nas/ gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams dang lha mo rnams kyi bha ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun chi li li babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam la/ gtso 'khor gyi sngags rnams bzla/ mthar rnam rgyal chen po'i lha rnams bdud rtsir zhu/ bum nang gi lha la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang gnyis med du gyur par bsam mo/ de nas phyi gtor ni/ phyi rol du song nas shar du ind+ra sa pa ri wā ra ṇa ā karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes bkug oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas ind+ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba l̥ngta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum la sogs pas phul saṃ tripta sarba de wa tā sā dha kā sye shantiṃ ku ru sarba kadyantu siddhi rba ti ya thā su khaṃ su khe/ mer agna ye sa pa ri wā ra ṇa a karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ= agna ye sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum saṃ tripta sarba de wa tā sa dhā kā sye shintaṃ ku ru sarba kadyantu siddhi rba ti ya thā su khaṃ su khe/ lhor yaṃ sa pa ri= oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya ma sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum/ saṃ tripta sogs puṣṭi ku ru sogs gzhan la rigs 'gre lho nub tu rakṣa sa pa ri wā ra ṇa= sogs sa dha ka sye puṣṭi sogs gong bzhin nub tu/ wa ru nā= a karṣa ya= sogs sā dha kā sye wa shaṃ ku ru= nub byang du bā yu sa pa ri wā ra= sa dha ka sye wa shaṃ ku ru= byang du ku bai rā sa pa ri wā ra= mā ra ya sarba kadyantu= dbang ldan du mahā bhu ta sa nas mā ra ya steng du tsand+ra surya brahma ārya de ba ta sa pa ri= shintaṃ ku ru sarba= 'og tu be tse tri pri the wī de wa ta sa pa ri wā ra= sā dha ka sye shintaṃ ku ru sarba kadyantu siddhi rba ti la thā su khaṃ su khe/ de nas 'dod gsol/ dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyi bdag la srung*// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms shing*// dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzod// zhes 'dod gsol byas kyang rung*// nang du phebs nas cang ti'u 'khrol zhing sbyin pa la sogs thams cad kyis ni 'gro ba'i yid kyi 'dod pa mchog ni kun rdzogs mdzad// he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro ma sogs rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer thams cad phye mar brlags// gang zhig 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhing bla ma rgyal ba'i ye shes 'byung gnas mthar phyin mdzad// de ni snying rje chen po'i dbang gyur 'phags pa rnams kyi rtag tu myur bar bkra shis yin// zhes pa'i glu len zhing dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi de la lan gsum du bskor ro// de nas bdag 'jug len pa la/ oṃ badzra urgha ṭa ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo phyes te de las zhugs par bsam/ dbang bskur ba'i bla ma'i bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos mdzad par mos pas/ slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin gyis te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus bya/ gtor ma oṃ gyis sbyangs/ āḥyid dang mthun par mang por spel/ hūm̐ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ adya nutpanna totta oṃ aḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ gtor ma byin rlobs/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// lus srul la sogs gang ci yang*// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du dengs// ci ste ngas bsgo su zhig 'da'// rdo rje bdag po sku yis ni// lus srul las skyes 'gas byas te// 'dir ni brlag 'gyur gzhan du min// sa yi phyogs 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis dpal he ru ka mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal por 'jug cing dbang zhu bar byed pa la bar du gcod par brtsam pa gang su yang rung ba sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang klu dang lha ma yin dang gnod sbyin dang srin po dang*/

yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ rjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa rgan po dang rgan mo dang g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig 'di ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag phyag na rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba hūm̐ ka ra shin tu khros pa ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun nas rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs/ yungs thun 'thor/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol/ bgegs gtor dor/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug / thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ me dī ni sogs/ me yi ra ba rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ zhes srung ba'i ra gur bsgom/ oṃ badzra bhū mi sogs/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o= / sogs maṇḍal phul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag gi gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mig dar bcing*/ kye khyod su zhig / ces dri/ bdag ni skal bzang ngo*/ zhes lan btab/ zhes lan gtab snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa da yā mi/ lan gsum/ su ra te sa ma yast+waṃ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya tha su khaṃ zhes rdo rje snying gar gtugs pas byin gyis brlab a khāṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis dngos su yol ba'i nang du khrid/ phyi dkyil gyi lho sgo nas g.yon skor gyis shar khyams su zhugs pa/

gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyis thugs kar bkug ste padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyi'i shar khyams su bzhag pa skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad kyi gzugs su gyur/ lha rnams la dmigs pas phyag 'tshal bar mos te/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum/ thal mo me tog dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur mchog /stsal nas mgon pos bdag la ni// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon gyi las rnams dang*// sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig ni// sdom pa gsang ba bla na med// rtag tu sems can kun don phyir// slob dpon du 'gyur bdag la gsungs// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ dkyil 'khor ba la che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di/ rdo rje 'dzin pa deng bdag 'dir// byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin zhing*// gsang ba'i don gyi 'khor lo 'dir// dam tshig sdom la 'jug par 'tshal/ zhes gsol/ de nas slob mar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i// gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni// bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam// zhes brjod/ slob mas kyang*/ bdag ni rab tu de 'tshal lo// zhes khas blangs/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// blo chen gyis ni bzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang deng rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni bzung bar bya// 'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya// de las gzhan pa bcu bzhi ni// phas pham par ni rab tu bshad// spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste// rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do//

zhes dam tshig sgrag /thun mong gi sdom pa blang ba slob mas/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te mchog tu bzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa blang ba/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma ni snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag dus 'di nas bzungs nas// ji srid gnyis med la gnas pa// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*/

zhes lan gsum/ dam bzhag bzhi ka'am/ bsdu na/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ totta kahūṃ/ mna' chu blud/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bla ma dang gtso bo gnyis su med pa'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i 'am rang gi gnas gsum du zhugs pas lus mer zhu bar bsam/ tiṣṭha ma hā kro ta ā be sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bidyā ma hā bi dyā rā dza dhīḥm he swā hā zhes dpa' bo bskul ba'i sngags bgrang*/ bdud rtsi lnga/ rdul gyis sbags pa'i bu mo'i 'doms dkris/ byi la'i brun gu gul bsres pa thod par bcug pa yi dgas kyi me la bsregs te bdug /rol mo'i sgra drag po bsgrags pas slob dpon nus pa che na de la dpal he ru ka dngos su phebs par gyur la/ gzhan du cha shas tsam mo/ phebs na/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod cing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gyis rnam par bzhag ste brtan par bya'o// de nas rigs brtag pa'i phyir/ bdag gi rigs gang yin pa'i lha de la phog par gyur cig snyam pas/ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes pas me tog gi 'phreng ba dor bas gang la phog pa lhag pa'i lhar brda sprad/ pra ti gṛ hna st+waṃ mi maṃ sa twa ma hwa ba la/ zhes dngos grub kyi tshul lam lha des rjes su 'dzin par dgongs pas 'phreng ba slob ma'i spyi bor bcings par mos/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra ni tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ zhes mig dar dkrol/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlobs//

ces brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mngon sum du mthong bar blta'o 'jug pa'o/ de nas bum pa'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod sbyin ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// lan gsum/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa dang*/ slob ma khaṇḍa ro hi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ slob ma 'am bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje de las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin cing phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing dar dang rin po ches spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar sa bon de las rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa cha gnyis gdan gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ bum rdzas dang slob ma la ye shes pa thim/ bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu ba'i bum chur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa dam tshig gi chus gang bas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs ring du skrod par mdzad de/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin dag pa'i sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin chu'i rgyun gyis lus bkrus pas rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang chu'i khams/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang*/ de'i dbang gis bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/

de bzhin/ slob ma dang cod pan bsangs sbyangs/ slob ma 'am bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi cod pan mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las trāṃ las rin chen/ de las rdo rje nyi ma dmar po/ rin po che dang rin chen dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug dang rin po che drug gis brgyan cing*/ dar dang rin chen gyis spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar sa bon de las rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa cha gnyis gdan gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/

cod pan dang slob ma la ye shes pa thim/ dbang rdzas kyi rin 'byung 'od du zhu ba'i cod pan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs ring du skrod par mdzad de/ ral pa'i thor tsugs kyis brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇan ni ye hūṃ/ zhes bskon/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin cod pan gyis dbang bskur bas/ tshor ba'i phung po dang*/ nam mkha'i khams dang*/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal/ de'i dbang gis bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi shes mngon sum du byas/ rdo rje dang slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ slob 'am bdag dang rdzas kyi rdo rje mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas padma de las snang ba mtha' yas mthing kha padma dang padma'i dril bu 'dzin cing phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing dar dang rin po ches spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar sa bon de las rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa cha gnyis gdan gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ rdo rje slob ma la ye shes pa thim/ dbang rdzas kyi snang ba mtha' yas 'od zhu ba'i rdor rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rdo rjes dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs ring du skrod par mdzad de/

thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes rdo rje lag pa g.yas su sbyin/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis rang bzhin rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas 'du shes kyi phung po dang*/ me'i khams/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags*/ de'i dbang gis bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ slob ma dang dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ slob ma 'am bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi dril bu mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las rta mchog ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug dang rin po che drug gis brgyan cing*/ dar dang rin chen gyis spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar sa bon de las rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa cha gnyis gdan gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ dril bu dang slob ma la ye shes pa thim/ dbang rdzas kyi rta mchog 'od du zhu ba'i dril bur gyuur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dril bu'i dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs ring du skrod par mdzad de/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod gyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// g.yon du sbyin/ don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin dril bu'i dbang bskur bas 'du byed kyi phung po dang*/ rlung gi khams/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog /de'i dbang gis bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/

bya ba grub ba'i ye shes mngon sum du byas/ de nas slob ma'am bsangs sbyangs/ slob ma 'am bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi cod pan mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrum̐ las 'khor lo de las rnam par snang mdzad ser po 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug dang rin po che drug gis brgyan cing*/ dar dang rin chen gyis spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar sa bon de las rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa cha gnyis gdan gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ slob ma la ye shes pa thim/ dbang rdzas kyi rnam par snang mdzad 'od du zhu ba'i rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rdo rje dang dril bu spyi bor 'dzin pas ming gi dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs ring du skrod par mdzad de/ dpa' bo lag tu rdo rje dril// gzung ngo 'khor lo gsum bdag nyid// rang bzhin gyis mdzes dga' ba ni// phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs// des rdor dril bsnol thabs su gzung bcug /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta che ge mo badzra st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi swā hā/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin ming gi dbang bskur bas gzugs kyi phung po dang*/ sa'i khams/ nyon mongs pa gti mug de'i dbang gis bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon sum du byas/ de rnams kyis ma rig pa lnga las bzlog nas rig pa'i ye shes lnga bskyed pas rig pa'i dbang thob pa zhes bya'o// dbang 'dis rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud nyan pa dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa dang*/

rnal 'byor rgyud man chad 'chad pa la dbang ba yin no/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas 'thon/ slob ma 'am rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum tu gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs te snying ga'i sa bon dang sngags kyi 'phreng ba la rim pa bzhin thim pa'i mos pa gyis byas la/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ sogs yab yum gyi snying po nye snying*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wi re sha ya sogs rtsa sngags rkang pa brgyad pa dang*/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru sogs 'phreng ba'i sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ rdo rje dang me tog spyi bor bkod de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// snying po yin ni ye shes mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus pa ni// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs// zhes sngags dbang bskur/ rdo rje gtad/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka yi brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi/ badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ tiṣṭa e ka ya st+waṃ dha ra ya mi oṃ ha ha ha hi/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs/ de nas kha ṭwaṃ thod pa cang te'u phyag rgya drug sbyin nas/ sna tshogs bsam pa'i bye brag gis// gang gi spyod pa rnam dag pa// 'dod la thugs rje'i gtso bo yis// sems can don ni byed pa'i thabs// nga yi spyod pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin// zhes spyod pa'i brtul zhugs dang*/ 'di ni rang nyid mdzes pa ste// bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sgoms pa yi// man ngag las ni 'di mi shes// rig pa 'di ni dor byas nas// thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya// brtul zhugs rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bu yi spyod// rig ma'i brtul zhugs so/ de nas slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi sna ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar byas te gzung*/

g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pas/ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid khyod// rang nyid sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin// he ru ka dpal zhes bya ba'i// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin no// shrī he ru ka ḍā ki nī nā ma sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi sa ma ya st+waṃ bhūr bhu waḥswaḥ lung bstan/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las rnam rgyal ba'i// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// zhes dbugs dbyung*/ de nas phyir mi ldog pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che// dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsol// 'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa// de ni de ring mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma'am rang nyid seng ges btegs pa'i khrir 'khod pa la steng du gdugs dkar po phub pa'i 'og tu/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ind+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tsugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thams can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa/

thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra st+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ thod pa dum bu'i ska rags can/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor sku rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo āḥdamar po/ snying gar thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ gtso bo'i snying kar oṃ haḥ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ na ma hi dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swa hā hu spyi bor rin chen 'byung gnas dmar po/ bau ṣa ṭa he phrag pa gnyis la he ru ka nag po/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ spyan gsum la 'od dpag med mthing ka phaṭ haṃ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad la don yod grub pa ljang khu/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ paṃ phag mo dmar mo/ haṃ yau snying gar gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ khar rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hreṃ hriṃ dpral bar skyod byed ma ser mo// hūm̐ hūm̐ spyi bor skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad la tsandi ka dud kha/ thams cad kyang gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yab rnams thor tshugs stag sham/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ yum rnams skra grol gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs spyan drangs rdo rje sems dpas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/

yum lngas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa he ru ka'i rang bzhin gyi chus dbang bskur/ dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ sgo mtshams kyi khro mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i bya ba mdzad bzhin pas/ rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyis// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// zhes rnam rgyal gyi bum pa spyi bor bkod/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rgyun lud pa spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag bum pa'i dbang thob// lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ lha tshogs thams cad de dang gnyis su med par thim pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen por gyur par bsam ste/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ de la sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas mchod par bsam te/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ sogs/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas// mi bya ba ni cung zad med// de nyid shes pa de nas ni// dpa' bo 'dod pa lnga spyod do// bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos// bdag nyid lha mo gyi kun dngos// de phyir bdag gi thams cad bya// bdag nyid he ru ka mchod bya// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung chos can// sems can rgyu yi rang bzhin no// khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// zhes phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skyob pa med pa rnams kyi skyabs// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa ni// bltos med thugs rje chen po yis// bdag cag rnams kyi mgon mdzod cig

/kye ho mgon gtso khyed rnams kyis// theg chen ting 'dzin ji lta ba// 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// lan gsum/ de nas gtso mo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas yab yum gyi phung po khams skye mched thams cad la khyab pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi lha thams cad gsang gnas su 'dus rdo rje'i lam dang ze ba nas bha gar babs pa gsang ba de nas lce thog tu sbyin par mos te/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin byang chub sems rgyun gyis// de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro// zhes khas a ho ma hā su kha zhes myang*/ gsang dbang ngo*// de nas bla mas/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dam tshig chen po rmad byung ba// khams lnga las byung bcud kyis len// bde ba chen pos myang bar gyis// zhes dam tshig phog /des ngag gi dri ma dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rtsa rlung thig le bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// gsang dbang ngo*/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal dang*/ thal mo sbyar te/ skyob pa med pa rnams kyi skyabs// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa ni// bltos med thugs rje chen po yis// bdag cag rnams kyi mgon mdzod cig /kye ho mgon gtso khyed rnams kyis// theg chen ting 'dzin ji lta ba// 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs//
