zhes lan gsum gsol gdab/ slob ma 'am rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ind+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tsugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thams can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra st+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ phyag rgya rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal bar gyur/ de'i lag pa nas bla mas gzung ste/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che// bde ba mtha' yas ster byed ma// blangs nas bu yi dus kun tu// bla na med pa'i mchod pa gyis// zhes gtad/ phyag rgya des/ dpa' bo bu khyod ci la spro// byang chub sems ni bza' ba dang*// rigs lnga las ni rab tu byung*// rig ma gus pas yang dag mchod// bshang gci stobs dang dri chen sogs// de ni so sor bza' ba dang*// gzhan yang mdzes pa'i dam tshig rnams// ji ltar spro ba bu yis smros//

zhes dri ba la/ ji ltar gsung pa'i dam tshig rnams// lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba'i phyir// padma rtag tu cis mi mchod// de nas des rang gi bha ga rgyas pa lag gis phye ste bhañdza mokṣa ho zhes brjod cing*/ de'i nang gi rtsa sor mos bskul te/ mkha' hrīḥlas padma dang*/ ze'u 'bru āḥs mtshan pa/ rtags hūṃ las rdo rje dang nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ phaṭ kyis gnyis ka'i thig le rgyu ba'i bu ga bkag par bsams te/ snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes mngon du bya'o// des dbang gsum pa thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag /pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// bla mas/ deng nas gzung ste bu khyod kyis// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// rmi 'dra sems can thams cad kyi// don gyi bdag nyid kun gyis shig gsum pa'o// de nas/ dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyang du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas// sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi las// rnam kun mchog gi sdom pa'o// sdom pa byang chub bde mchog ste// bltar med brjod du med pa'o// zhes tshig gis brda sprad pa bzhi pa'o/ /dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes kyi dri ma dag /phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// de nas/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇḍal rgyas bsdus gang rung dang yon 'bul/ de nas dga' ba brjod par bya ste/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to//

zhes so// ༈ de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ tshogs rdzas rnams oṃ khanḍa ro hi sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs tshogs rnams mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du a las padma'i snod dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba thod pa gsum gyi sgyed pu la gnas pa'i nang du oṃ āṃ trāṃ khāṃ hūm̐/ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga rlung gis bskul bas me 'bar thod pa bsros pas rdzas rnams zhu ba nyi ma 'char kha'i kha dog can de'i steng du dngul chu'i mdog can gyi hūm̐ las byung ba'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po thur du blta ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu bas ro gcig par gyur pa rnams a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e āai o āau aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭhaḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ ā li g.yon skor/ kā li g.yas skor du song ba yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge brtsegs mar gnas pa de dag las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas 'od du zhu nas yi ge gsum la rim pa bzhin thim/ oṃ yig zhu bas sbyangs/ āḥyig gis mang por spel/ hūm̐ yig gis sbar ba dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ tshogs phud drug tu bcad/ tshogs phud dang po 'bul ba la thugs gtad par zhu/ zhes las kyi rdo rjes gsol/ mchod do phud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rigs thams cad kyi dbang phyug dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ rtsa brgyud kyi rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hi/

gnyis pa/ oṃ badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki ni dzwa la samba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ sarba bhuddha ḍā ki ni ye badzra warṇa nīye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsa kra= oṃ ḍā ki ni ye= oṃ lā me= oṃ khanḍa ro hi= oṃ rū pi ni ye= ga ṇa= oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ bi ri sha ya/ mahā kalpaka sogs rtsa sngags dang*/ phreng sngag kyi mthar*/ ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ kā kā sye= oṃ ā lu kā sye= oṃ shwa nā kā sye= oṃ sū ka rā sye= ga ṇa= oṃ ya ma da dhi= oṃ ya ma dū ti= oṃ ya ma daṃ ṣṭi nī ye= oṃ ya ma ma thā ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hi/ gsum pa/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza= bzhi pa/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du ga ṇa tsa kra pū= lnga pa/ dpal ma hā ka la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum gyi sman pa/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma chen mo bya rog ming can 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du ga ṇa= drug pa/ gzhan yang yul phyogs 'di nyid la gnas pa la sogs lha ma srin sde brgyad/ 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas rnam bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hi/ yul lha sogs la'o/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi= oṃ swa bhā wa nas stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/

de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a las padma'i snod dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba thod pa gsum gyi sgyed bu la gnas pa'i nang du/ oṃ āṃ trāṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga rlung gis bskul bas me 'bar thod pa bsros pas rdzas rnams zhu ba nyi ma 'char ka'i kha dog can/ de'i steng dngul chu'i kha dog can gyi hūm̐ las byung ba'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po thur du blta ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu bas ro gc-ig par gyur pa rnams a ā i ī nas aṃ ā ka kha ga gha nas ḍa ḍha a li g.yon bskor ka li g.yas bskor du songs ba yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge brtsegs mar gnas pa de dag las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams 'phros 'gro ba'i don byas snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas 'od du zhu nas yi ge gsum la rim pa bzhin thim/ oṃ yig zhu bas sbyangs/ āḥyig gis mang por spel/ hūm̐ yig gis sbar ba dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma bza' ba bca' ba chang la sogs pa'i btung ba ji tsam rnyed pa byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang stang stabs bcas/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ gu ru shrī badzra he ru kaḥ.akaḍḍha ya akaḍḍha ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ bandha ya bandha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba badzra ḍā ki ni hri da ya/ a ba to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ āṃḥhūm̐/ sarba wi ra yo gi nī swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang bcas byang sems thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de la / oṃ āḥbadzra arghaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin du/ oṃ= pādyaṃ= añtsa mā nī= puṣpe= dhu pe= ā lo ke= ghandhe= nai widye= shapta hūm̐= oṃ= ā darsha= wi ni= ghandhe= rasye= oṃ= sparshe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a āḥ.i īḥ

sogs zhes pa nas aṃ āḥlag pa g.yon a li las zla ba/ ka kha ga gha nga sogs nas ḍa ḍha/ lag pa g.yas kā li las nyi ma kha sbyor gyi bar du hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sarba dharm+māpa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣṭaḥ sarba dharm+mā a tantu a nu pra biṣṭaḥsarba dharmāḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐ de dag yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i thal mo/ de'i steng du gtor ma bzhag nas bzhes pa'i don du lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// de gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / de nas lag pa pad kor byas te/ sa ma yast+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas mchod bya mchod byed/ mchod pa thams cad tha mi dad par gyur/ oṃ a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ driṣya hoḥ gtso bo nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar la phyogs g.yon/ mtsham g.yas bskor gyis 'bul zhing*/ ye shes kyi mgron gzhan thams cad la/ o ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis stob bo de nas lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje dkar po sbu gu can gyi sa gsol bas mnyes par gyur/ sngar bzhin oṃ āḥbadzra arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar dang*/ 'don yon lnga'i sngags bcas kyi mchod do// bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug sogs dang dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ji snyed ma sogs kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pas chags pa bcom zhing yang dag lta ba bcom// khyod ni dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi brjid kyis brlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyi shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod pa 'dis dngos grub blangs phyag rgya sngar bzhin gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/

sarba yakṣa/ rākṣas/ bhūta/ preta/ pi shā tsa/ utmā da/ apa smā ra/ badzra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhnantu/ sa ma ya rakṣan tu/ ma ma sarba siddhi me pra yatstshantu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ khā da tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi gha tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka ra ta ya/ sat+su khaṃ/ bi shuddhaye sa hā e ka bha wan tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes lan gsum gy-is 'bul/ dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis// sogs gong bzhin brjod ces 'dod pa'i dngos grub blangs/ brda'i lag pas brda bsten te/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes bya ba bzod cing padma skor pa'i phyag rgyas mnyes par byas te nye bar bsdu ba'i phyag rgya mi phyed par 'khyud pa sngon du 'gro bas mthe bong dang srin lag se gol brdab par bya ste/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol// oṃ badzra muḥ/ gtor mgron ye shes pa rnams bdag nyid la thim// 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ skyes pa'i thod pa bzang por myos byed rnam pa brgyad po gang rung gis bkang ste padma'i bskor bas/ gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa dang*// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs nas gsol// zhes slob dpon la stob des padma'i bskor ba'i mthar/ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi mchog /'dod chags dri ma med pa 'di// gzung 'dzin rnam par grol ba yin// de bzhin du ni bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod pas blangs te btung*/ de nas bza' ba sogs longs spyod/ mo gtso bo yin na sha thog mar rol/ de nas phyag rgya dang spyod de rgyu 'di las ni tshogs kyi 'khor lor 'gyur la/

gzhan yid kyis rol pa tsam ni ston mo zhes brjod kyis/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i ming mi thob bo// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi kha chang gis bkang*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas hūm̐ zhes drag pos kha khru btab la/ oṃ āḥbadzra paṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nas nai widye oṃ sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi u tstshiṣṭa ba lingta u tstshiṣṭa bhakṣe bhyaḥswā hā/ zhes 'byung po 'chol ba rnams la sbyin/ sbyin pa la sogs thams cad kyis ni 'gro ba'i yid kyi 'dod pa mchog ni kun rdzogs mdzad/ he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro ma sogs rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer thams cad phye mar brlag /gang zhig 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhing bla ma rgyal ba'i ye shes 'byung gnas mthar phyin mdzad// de ni snying rje chen pos dbang gyur 'phags pa rnams kyi rtag tu myur bar bkra shis yin// sogs kyi bkra shis kyi glu blang ngo*// de nas dge ba bsngo ba/ he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor du// tshogs kyi 'khor lo mchod pa yis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /nyes ltung dri mas ma gos shing*// rlabs chen spyod pa rdzogs pa dang*// he ru ka dang mnyam pa yi// go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par shog /'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum bsags pa yi// yod pa'i dge ba ma lus gcig bsdus nas// bde chen byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du// sku gsum rgyal srid chen po thob par shog /

ces smon lam gdab/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba la/ gtang rag gi don du/ oṃ āḥbadzra arghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ padyaṃ= /añtsa ma ṇaṃ= puṣpe= nas shapta 'i bar dang*/ a darsha= bī ni= gandhe= ra sya= sparshe= dharme zhes mchod/ gang gis drin gyi sogs dang*/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs bshags dang bzod gsol bya/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa rten la bstim/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ snying kha'i 'od kyi snod bcud thams cad bsdus te gzhal yas khang*/ de yang me long la rlangs pa 'du ba bzhin he ru ka lnga la/ 'khor bzhi gtso bo la/ gtso bo'i lus kyi dpa' mo nyer bzhi rtsa'i rang bzhin/ dpa' bo khams byang chub sems kyi rnam pas gang bar gyur pa de dag lha mo bcu gnyis la/ de dbus kyi gtso bo yab yum la/ yum yab la/ de yas 'dus mas 'dus te nyi ma'i steng gi hūm̐ ye shes lnga'i ngo bo la/ de rim gyis 'dus te sgra ris tsam/ de yang stong nyid du yal bas phyi'i sku gcig tu 'dus par gyur pa/ de'i lus oṃ la/ ngag āḥl/ yid hūm̐ la/ gnyis po hūm̐ gcig pu la/ de yang nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa bzhin je chung du song nas stong nyid dbyings dang dbyer med du gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag /de las ldang tshe slar yang he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur ldang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal sogs dge ba bsngo zhing shis pa brjod pas yongs su dge bar bya'o// dbang gi sta gon dang 'jug pa dkyil 'khor rgyas pas kha bskang na bcu gsum ma'i dbang bsdus par yang 'gyur ro// zhes padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /maṅga laṃ//
